name: Farm barn
summary: The gambrel barn silhouette and checkerboard-trimmed doors are recognisable, but the huge unbroken slate-black roof, hollow loft opening and blown-out gable make it read more like a dark lid on a red box than a classic red barn.

log.summary: The gable end reads clearly as a stepped barn with doors, loft and cupola, but the roof is a heavy black lid and the long side walls are mostly white with sparse red slots, so it only half reads as a classic red barn.
